data.body:
[P1] Preserve EXECUTING when an async success checkpoint is dropped

After a map/parallel ancestor finishes, `checkpoint(SUCCEED)` calls `releaseAbandonedOperation()` and marks this step `COMPLETED`. This branch then continues into the operation hooks while the step is completed; `completeAfter` restores `EXECUTING` only afterwards. SDK invariant 1 and ADR 0002 permit that early completion only when the caller never resumes, so synchronous hook work now falls outside the required lifecycle. Make checkpoint abandonment distinguish awaited and asynchronous success updates, keeping asynchronous steps `EXECUTING` through their finishing work, and add coverage without weakening the existing contract cases.
